changes.title: Art cache followups
items: Saved pictures can load before the drawing tools.
Party animals in matching outfits share saved pictures, drawn for their current age.

changes.title: Projected creature fit
items: Creatures grow from witch-sized youngsters into larger adults and legends.
Twenty creatures have new shapes and natural markings.

changes.title: Readable logs
items: Pause now offers a readable text log alongside the builders' JSON log. Repeated messages show counts, and older routine records make room for warnings and errors.
